dialogues.speaker: Polovikova
dialogues.text: Will Lady Vodyanitsa be on stage today...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you here for the performance?

dialogues.speaker: Polovikova
dialogues.text: That's right! You've heard of Lady Vodyanitsa, haven't you?... Ah, forgive me — of course you have! She's the brightest star on this stage...

dialogues.speaker: Polovikova
dialogues.text: Her voice is as pure as moonlight itself, and her beauty sparkles like a stream beneath the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Polovikova
dialogues.text: Ah... Just thinking about her is enough to leave me spellbound all over again...

dialogues.speaker: Polovikova
dialogues.text: Ah, if only I could hear Lady Vodyanitsa sing every day...
